note: SPAX11 presents with spastic ataxia whereas TUBA4A variants are also implicated in ALS/FTD, making distinctive absent or exclusionary features biologically and clinically sound.

evidence.text: Alpha-tubulin 4A (TUBA4A) was originally linked to familial amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and frontotemporal dementia, but variants also specifically cause hereditary spastic ataxia, highlighting distinct clinical presentations within the spectrum.

source.title: De novo and inherited monoallelic variants in TUBA4A cause ataxia and spasticity
source.quote: Alpha-tubulin 4A encoding gene (TUBA4A) has been associated with familial amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and frontotemporal dementia, based on identification of likely pathogenic variants in patients from distinct amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and frontotemporal dementia cohorts.

evidence.text: TUBA4A p.Glu415Lys was identified as causing spastic ataxia distinct from previously described phenotypes, expanding the differential diagnosis for spastic ataxia disorders.

source.title: A new genetic cause of spastic ataxia: the p.Glu415Lys variant in TUBA4A
source.quote: The phenotype, not previously described, is that of spastic ataxia. Our findings widen the phenotypic and genetic manifestations of TUBA4A variants and add a new type of spastic ataxia to be taken into consideration in the differential diagnosis.
